children: Piedmont Realty Trust announced a proposed $200 million exchangeable senior notes offering and reported recent acquisition and disposition activity.
Proposed private offering of $200,000,000 exchangeable senior notes due 2031, guaranteed by Piedmont Realty Trust.
Operating partnership may grant initial purchasers option to buy up to $30,000,000 additional notes.
Intend to use proceeds to redeem outstanding 9.250% senior notes due 2028 and for concurrent share repurchases up to ~$50 million.
Acquired 4075 Wilson Boulevard, a ~189,000 sq ft Class A office in Ballston, Arlington for ~ $52.7 million; 83% leased, 5.5-year WALT.
Completed sale of 10.6-acre Royal Lane land parcel in Dallas for ~ $12.0 million and contracted to sell certain office properties for ~ $80 million (subject to conditions).
